findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes with nil TopicUser and changes state on a GET
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by` returns nil when the user has no topic_users row, for example after watching via category settings or following a link from an old email. `tu.notification_level` then raises NoMethodError and the user gets a 500. The action also mutates notification state on a GET, so link prefetchers or mail scanners can unsubscribe users. Use `TopicUser.change`, which creates the row if missing, or guard against nil.

findings.title: Missing visibility and permission checks and user lookup
findings.body: `TopicView.new(params[:topic_id], current_user)` is not wrapped in the `rescue Discourse::NotFound` handling that `show` has. The `show` action also removes notifications on `InvalidAccess`, which this action does not do. Separately, `ensure_logged_in` is applied, so a logged-out user clicking the email link gets a login error rather than a clear path to unsubscribing.

findings.title: Added `render :show` changes the behaviour of `show`
findings.body: `perform_show_response` is shared by `show`, but `render :show` is now added to its html branch. The branch previously relied on the implicit render. For the `unsubscribe` action this explicit render is needed, but it is a change to shared code and should be verified for `show`.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link now requires %{unsubscribe_url} everywhere
findings.body: `unsubscribe_link` is also used by other emails that set `add_unsubscribe_link` but do not pass `unsubscribe_url`. Examples are the digest, signup and other `build_email` callers. I18n raises MissingInterpolationArgument or leaves the placeholder in the body for those emails. The spec was patched to pass `unsubscribe_url` to work around this, which shows it is a real break.

findings.title: Misspelled property name `stopNotificiationsText`
findings.body: The property name `stopNotificiationsText` is misspelled. It is consistent with the template, so it works, but it will confuse maintainers. Rename it to `stopNotificationsText` in both files.
